mechanism_claims.claim_text: LJ-hep2(66-86) causes bacterial surface/membrane morphology damage consistent with membrane-integrity disruption in E. coli, P. aeruginosa, and A. hydrophila.
mechanism_claims.limitations: SEM morphology supports membrane/cell-envelope damage but does not establish a single molecular target or pore architecture.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: LJ-hep2(66-86) promotes concentration-dependent bacterial agglutination for E. coli, P. aeruginosa, and A. hydrophila.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Agglutination is a direct phenotype and surface-interaction support, not proof of a unique intracellular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Rapid killing kinetics and retained activity after heat treatment support a direct bactericidal peptide phenotype under the tested in vitro conditions.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Time-kill and thermal-stability results support activity profile, not a molecular target.

mechanism_claims.limitations: This is efficacy/immunoprotection context and should not be promoted to a separate molecular immune mechanism.
